name: Example Neon Compilation
theme: Optimistic instrumental synthwave with warm analogue synthesizers, driving drum machines and memorable melodies.
thematicOpening: Music for the nights worth remembering.
arrangementNotes: Begin brightly, create a reflective middle passage and finish with renewed momentum.

tracks.title: First Light
tracks.direction: A confident, energetic opening with a memorable lead melody.
tracks.prompt: Instrumental optimistic synthwave with warm analogue synthesizers, driving drum machines, melodic bass and a bright memorable lead. Energetic opening, cinematic polish, no vocals.
tracks.arrangementNotes: Establish the compilation's melodic identity immediately.

tracks.title: Afterglow
tracks.direction: A moderate, nostalgic closing track with a hopeful resolution.
tracks.prompt: Instrumental nostalgic retrowave with warm pads, restrained drum machines, expressive analogue lead synthesizer and a hopeful sunrise resolution. Moderate energy, no vocals.
tracks.arrangementNotes: Leave space in the final passage for a calm resolution.
